1879048835.name: a ranged attack
1879048835.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a bow.

1879063043.name: Track Crops
1879063043.desc: When active, nearby crops are displayed on the radar.

1879073027.name: Bracing Attack
1879073027.desc: You make an attack which allows you to brace yourself against counterattack, increasing your Morale by a small amount.

1879094787.name: Paranoia
1879094787.desc: You're not sure what, but something isn't right.

1879172995.name: Clear Defeat
1879172995.desc: Removes tier 1 dread obtained from defeat.

1879198339.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Ember-eagle)
1879198339.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879207043.name: Steed of Bright Days
1879207043.desc: A brightly coloured theme sets this horse apart from the rest of the herd.

1879212931.name: Improved Startling Twist
1879212931.desc: Stun multiple enemies and remove Corruptions.

1879214595.name: Desolation
1879214595.desc: Let out a deafening cry, striking terror into the enemies before you and dealing strong Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879215875.name: Inspire (Song-brother)
1879215875.desc: A melee attack that restores Power to your Song-brother.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.
You gain a personal benefit when using Inspire.

1879260035.name: Quick Shot
1879260035.desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.

1879262979.name: Goading Strike
1879262979.desc: You strike, not necessarily to deal damage, but to goad your foe into attacking you. You will be ready for their next attack and your strategy helps you and your allies deal additional damage.

1879273475.name: Smashing Strike
1879273475.desc: After using Shield-swipe or Retaliation, smash the enemy with your weapon's blunt pommel or haft.\nIf after Shield-swipe: damage and stun.\nIf after Retaliation: damage and bleed.

conditionalEffects.description: Smashing Strike will cash out maximum stacks of Fortification for a 15% group damage buff and personal +50% damage buff for 15s.\n\nBreak Ranks cannot trigger more than once each 60s.

1879276547.name: Piercing Roar
1879276547.desc: Your enemies feel sharp pain as you sound the call of battle.

1879284099.name: Banner - Vanguard
1879284099.desc: Place a banner that improves Vanguards.

1879316483.name: Fire Grim
1879316483.desc: Summons a fire grim to your side. It is fun at parties.

1879316995.name: Brutal Maul
1879316995.desc: You rear up and begin to thrash violently, swiftly dealing damage to enemies in front of you.

1879324035.name: Very Fancy Cat
1879324035.desc: Summons a cat to keep you company.

1879336963.name: Clever Retort
1879336963.desc:
Take a chance when removing an active Trick; apply one of four effects to the enemy based on the Trick removed.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Trick: Dust in the Eyes will restore Power and allow you to briefly enter Stealth

Trick: Disable will restore Morale

Trick: Enrage will apply a Damage over Time effect

Trick: Counter Defence will deal Damage</RGB>

1879358083.name: Deadly Slash
1879358083.desc: A powerful sword swing that damages several foes in an arc.

1879369987.name: Farmers Feast Steed
1879369987.desc: A pony from the Farmers Faire.

1879373187.name: Storm-cloud
1879373187.desc: Brings out a storm-cloud to keep you company.

1879389059.name: Big Honey Bee
1879389059.desc: Brings out a big honey bee to keep you company.

1879389955.name: Hobbit-sense
1879389955.desc: Sometimes plain old hobbit-sense serves you best.

1879409155.name: Cart Pony
1879409155.desc: Summons a loveable and hard-working pony.

1879414275.name: Brown Bear Cub
1879414275.desc: Summons a cuddly brown bear cub.

1879449987.name: Thrash - Tier 2 (Dual)
1879449987.desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage of the Beorning, stacking up to three times.

1879467267.name: Caustic Brew
1879467267.desc: A pot filled with a corrosive substance. Creates a pool of acid on the ground that burns through armour and hide alike.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879475971.name: Return to Lond Cirion
1879475971.desc: You're able to quickly return to Lond Cirion. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879486467.name: Water Buffalo Calf
1879486467.desc: Summons an adorable water buffalo calf to accompany you on your travels.

1879489155.name: Flashing Flank
1879489155.desc: This skill creates a burst of light in front of the targeted enemy causing them to become Flanked.

1879495171.name: Impressive Pumpkin
1879495171.desc: Places down a fine crop, sure to be the envy of any farmer, possibly even a contender in fairs.

1879495299.name: Memory of Triumph
1879495299.desc: A Memory of Triumph can be used to inspire an ally to greater feats on the battle-field.

1879496323.name: Illuminating Lantern
1879496323.desc: Place a small lantern on the ground to have a bit of extra light in the darkest of places.

1879508099.name: Long Shot: Elvish Arrow
1879508099.desc: Nock and loose an imprecise dart, which has a chance to greatly increase your Focus if it lands.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

1879518083.name: Icy Glare
1879518083.desc: The princess can let her disapproval be known with a mere look.

1879518723.name: Medicinal Bandage
1879518723.desc: Use to heal the injured thralls in Esh Mêkag.

1879525379.name: Pinwheel Fireworks
1879525379.desc: Set off a spinning pinwheel of fireworks!

1879527427.name: Broken Chain
1879527427.desc: Channel the power of broken chain to create a zone of protection against some of Thothrach's attacks. This power will also harm the user.
